text.p: - Slovenia's only port Luka Koper was closed on Sunday due to dense fog, with visibility below 100 meters, the Slovenian maritime office said.
- The Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) said that Slovenia's unemployment rate was expected to stabilise at 7.5 percent.
- Slovenia's parliament will vote on prime minister - designate Janez Drnovsek's proposed government line-up on Thursday.
- Slovenian high-jumper Britta Bilac came joint first in the athletic indoor Grand Prix tournament in Birmingham on Sunday, while 60 meter hurdle runner Brigita Bukovec came second.

- By law the waiting period for operations in Slovenian hospitals should not last longer than a year, but patients usually wait for heart operations up to a year and a half because of limited hospital capacity.
- Only 15.8 percent of voters turned out on municipal elections in the second biggest Slovenian town Maribor on Sunday.
